slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Google has introduced Gemma 4 QAT models, which optimize model compression for mobile and laptop efficiency.
The models use quantization-aware training (QAT) to reduce the size of AI models.
This allows for faster and more efficient deployment of AI models on devices.
The Gemma 4 QAT models were announced on 05 Jun 2026.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The Gemma 4 QAT models can help improve the performance of AI models on devices.
The models can reduce the energy consumption of AI models, making them more suitable for mobile devices.
The use of QAT can also improve the security of AI models by reducing the risk of data breaches.

slide1.headline: Pegatron Unit ASRock Rack Wins Order
slide1.subtitle: Supplying 587 GPU Servers for Thailand AI Data Center

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Pegatron unit ASRock Rack has won an order to supply 587 GPU servers for a Thailand AI data center.
The GPU servers will be used to support the development of AI applications.
The order is valued at an undisclosed amount.
The GPU servers will be delivered over the next few months.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The adoption of AI in data centers is driving the demand for GPU servers.
The use of GPU servers can improve the performance of AI applications.
The growth of AI in data centers is expected to drive the growth of the industry.
